name: – Loucas Fourlas, Ruggero Razza – After § 29 – Am 2
title: REPORT on an EU health workforce crisis plan: sustainability of healthcare systems and employment and working conditions in the healthcare sector
part_text: 29a. Believes that a sustainable solution to the healthcare workforce crisis depends on making healthcare professions more attractive; calls on the Member States to develop ambitious policies regarding initial and continuing education, the improvement of working conditions, the prevention of psychosocial risks and burnout, workplace safety, work-life balance, job stability and fair compensation; emphasises that retaining professionals who are already in the workforce is just as important a priority as recruiting new staff; emphasises that measures to address shortages of healthcare personnel must be based primarily on national policies for training, retention and career advancement, rather than on an increasing reliance on international recruitment; reiterates that each Member State must retain control over its health policy and the management of its healthcare workforce, while the EU’s actions must remain complementary and be based on the principle of subsidiarity;
